Welcome. I'm the chief consul of Sofya City\nand Goddess of Wisdom, Pino Sofys Loiz.\nOne of the twelve gods.
Thank you for coming all the way.\n...Oh, please keep still.\nCould you hold still for a second?
...You're so mysterious.\nYou're different from any tribes in this city.\nOf course, from us, gods too.
May I ask you a strange question?\nWhere is the place in your oldest memory?
Oh, you've lost your memory?\nYou don't even remember about this world?\nThat's quite strange...
And it's not good for your adventure.
I could explain about this world if you'd like.
This world was created by the former twelve gods.\nBut a huge earthquake split the earth apart long,\nlong time ago...
And people call it [Cataclysm].
People say it happened because they mined\ntoo many Goddess Beads or...
because twelve gods' power became weak.\nBut the real cause is still unknown...
When the cataclysm occurred, the twelve gods joined\nthe ground again but...
Since they had to do it very quickly, the shape\nbecame totally different from what it used to be.
It's been a long time since the cataclysm...\nThe four tribes in this world adapted to the\nenvironment.
They make their living in their own ways now but...
Strange incidents are still happening everywhere.\nI guess they're the aftermath of the cataclysm.
Especially brutalized monsters and modified dragon\nattacks are commonly heard...They all have weird\nblack thing attached on their bodies...
That's a brief story about this world.\nDid you get it?\n...Alright.
You might want to travel and see the world with\nyour own eyes.
...Why don't you go to [ffff64]Isthmus of Kaus[ffffff] first?
There's a huge hole and the dragon is said to have\nbeen there. You'll get a glimpse of the strange\nphenomenon occurring frequently in this world.
I just got a report about monsters attack.\nI'm worried about what's going on there.
I don't mean to send you on an errand but...\ncould you investigate the situation and report it\nto me, please?
Oh, before that...\nDo you know about the four factions in this world?
...I see. The people in the Straye faction make\ntheir living not only as adventurers.
Some are camping near the city. Why don't you\ntalk to them? But please be careful on your way.
? ...I think I saw you here once. No, I mean...\nYou've been to this world before...\nOh, I'm sorry. You lost your memory.
What? Well, I just mistook you for someone else.\nI've met a person who looks like you before but...
It was before I became the Goddess of Wisdom...\nI was the chief consul and the child of a god in\na country, so... It was hundreds of years ago.
Well, you look kinda different from the humans in\nthis world, but there is no way\na human like you can live for centuries...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
What? ...You wanna enter?\nDo you have the permission?\nThen, I can't let you pass.
Here we deal with lots of confidential matters.\nAnd the chief consul has no time for chatting.\nYou can't see her without an appointment.
You got it?\nGet lost, or I'll drag you out!
Thank you so much.\nHow was it? ...The dragon wasn't there?\nA crystal was giving off miasma...
That makes sense.\nThe miasma is affecting the monsters...
I guess the crystal has something to do with\nthe black stuff on the dragon's body.
...We need to find where the dragon is and\ndefeat it immediately to prevent further damage.
I'll issue the order to Sofyan guards and Straye\npeople to search and defeat the dragon.\nCould you give them a hand, please?
...I see. You must be tired too...\nPlease take a rest for today.
I'll ask you for help at a later date...
Oh, it's you. Did you have a good rest?\nI'm glad to hear that.
You're going to find the dragon? Thanks...\nOh, yes.\nHave you heard of holy gems?
...Then do you know about the Premiere Gem\nthat is the origin of holy gems?
Yes, I do!
No, I don't...
I see. That makes it easy.\nThe owner of the general store in this city said\nhe saw a gem like the Premiere Gem.
I see. It's a long story, so...\nYou might want to ask the old lady called Ryano in\nWanderers Camp.
Well, the owner of the general store in this city\nsaid he saw a gem like the Premiere Gem.
The gem was created by the chief god to\nhelp people...\nI haven't seen it with my own eyes but...
Could you ask him the details and look for it\nas well while searching for the dragon?
Thank you so much.\nOh... The Premiere Gem is sealing the monster...?
We need to renovate the temple for Arone...
Well, I was surprised to hear that the dragon was\ncrafty enough to wait for the chance until\nthe seal is broken...
Now it's clear the dragon has evil yet great\npower and spreads miasma.\nWe need to get rid of it as soon as possible.
Oh, you came at the right time.
Oh, you came at the right time.\nI've just got a report that the dragon was found\nin Nisel Mountain.
Some Straye people have already set off to defeat\nthe dragon. Could you go there, too?
I appreciate it. But, please be careful.\nI heard it's a sly dragon. There's no saying what\nit may do...
You should cooperate with other Straye people.\nI'm counting on you.
I see...\nSo, the dragon regained consciousness, right?
Yes. He wanted us to apologize to human beings on\nhis behalf. He said he would go back to the desert\nand wait for the order from the gods.
He couldn’t do anything but roar while the black\ncrystal was on his body, so... there's no doubt\nhe has come to himself now...
The black crystal must have been controlling him.\nI've seen that kind of stuff before. I believe\nit's not the same one but... I have a bad feeling.
Sooner or later, we need to find out what it is.\nThanks a lot. Please have a good rest and...\nOh, I almost forgot. Here's something for you...
Oh, it's you... About holy gems?\nMost people have heard of them but they don't\nreally know what exactly they are?
I'm not surprised. Elves used to hide\ntheir research even from the gods using\npowerful magic barriers...
Holy gems could pose a big threat to\nthis world if they are misused...
So, only a few people know where and how they\nare made...
Yes, I don't know much about them either but\nI've heard the name of a Resistle person who is\nconducting research on holy gems.
I think her name is... Naiata. She's an elf mage.\nWhy don't you find her first?
There are no other clues...\nLet's go find Naiata, the mage.
It sounds like people in the city don't know of\nNaiata... Let's collect the information from other\npeople.
Oh, it's you.\nI haven't seen you in a while, so I was worried\nabout you. Where have you been?
You reported that you got some information about\nthe gate of another world and deformed monsters.
And the monsters might attack the world again...
I see...Actually, I felt a whoosh of powerful evil\nenergy before but it vanished a few days later...\nSo, that was the cause...
Anyway, we can't just turn a blind eye to evil\nexistence including the black crystals you saw.\nMay I ask you to defeat the deformed monsters?
Thank you for your report.\nPlease have a rest for a while.
We'll collect the information about the gate of\nanother world that Majua is sealing to get the\nclues about the deformed monsters.
Did you have a good rest? That's great.\nAbout the gate of another world?
Unfortunately, I haven't got any clues about it...\nIt's frustrating...
And I've just got a worrying report...\n[ffff64]Straye soldiers are frequently attacked[ffffff] near\nthe Resistle's territory...
We can't leave it as it is either...
You'll find the gate of another world and\ninvestigate the incident at the same time?!\nBut, we don't have any clues, both of them.
...But you're right. We never know when the\ndeformed monsters will begin to invade this world.\n...We can't just sit here and do nothing.
...Okay. I'll leave them to you.\nI'll send someone to inform you if I receive\nany updates on both matters. Be careful...
...I'm out.
Why? How dare you ask me why?! I was expecting to\nmake lots of money by purchasing the holy gems\nand that's why I was with you!
But look what has happened to me!!\nI was chased by monsters all the time and got\nnothing!
That is why I'm NEVER going with you again!
You shouldn't give up just because you\nfailed to purchase the holy gems from Naiata.
W-What does that mean?
Naiata isn't the only person who creates holy\ngems.
There are many elf researchers that belong to\nthe Resistle who try to create holy gems.
Since they're creating holy gems with their own\ntechnics, there are various types of holy gems.
Someone might sell you the gems.
Oh, why didn't you tell me that earlier!\nOkay then, let's go!\nWhat're you doin'? Come on!
You reported about the sorcery gem to Pino...
I understood.\nI've never tried it before but...\nHopefully, I can be of your help...
Looks like I couldn't make it with\nmy power alone...I'm so sorry...
By the way, I've been feeling divine energy around\nEthos Fortress these days.\nHow about visiting there?
I guess he or she will give you a hand in this\nkind of situation.
You can challenge the special battle for\n5 Million Downloads.\nFull party is strongly recommended.
A strange structure in the ruins...?\nDo you have any other information...?
You forgot to retrieve Pelulu's drawing from\nLilulu at the library!!
What's wrong? ...You didn't get it back?!\nMeh, sometimes you're really careless!\nGive me a piece of paper and pen!
Pelulu drew exactly the same drawing!!\nHer unexpected talent in drawing is astounding...
Something like this was occupying the whole ruins...
I-It's... wizard cannon!!
W-Wizard canyon? What's that?
Wizard cannon is a magic weapon created by a consul\nwho was working with me in a republic which once\nexisted.
It was made to protect the republic at first,\nhowever, a man who was obsessed with greed\ntried to use it to control the republic...
S-So, how strong is the wizard cannon?
It can cause a massive destruction by emitting\nthe energy stored in the huge crysta all at once.
It could blow up Sofya City at that time in a\nmoment even though it was 5 times larger than\nit is now...
Whoa?!\nIs that such a dangerous stuff?!\nBut why it's in the ruins?
I have no idea...\nHis plan was found out right before launch and\nit was stopped.
After that, the wizard cannon was dismantled and\ndestroyed to prevent misuse. But why...?
If the wizard cannon is brought back and\ncontrolled by evil people, it will become\nthe worst threat to this world for sure...
By the way, was it loaded with a huge crysta?
A huge crysta... huge enough to be put in the\nhole?! T-That's an incredible treasure!
I wouldn't fail to notice it if it was there!\nI didn't see anything.
It should be safe if a huge crysta isn't loaded yet\nbut...
Well, the wall and the floor were glittering and\nwe heard noises...
What?!\nWhy didn't you say that?!
C-Cuz you didn't ask me!\nThere was no huge crysta, so it's alright, isn't it?
That means the engine of the wizard cannon has\nbeen restored and it just needs a huge crysta to\nshoot!
Whaaat?!
We can't let anyone load a huge crysta into the\nwizard cannon. We must stop it...
But crystas are decreasing in number, right?\nHow can they create a huge crysta?
Have you heard that Simcracker the magic weapon\nwas used when Eldenbaum was occupied?
Simcracker?!\nI heard it from King Elbano...
Before the invasion, I got a report saying there\nwas a small ground explosion that might have been\ncaused by Simcracker in another place.
The ground didn't largely collapsed, and there was\nno victim, so I didn't really care but...
If my guess is right, the explosion was caused\nby Simcracker to find the vein of crystas and
dig the ground to build some kind of facility\nunderground.\nIt's not far from Singolare Ruins...
If there is a factory to create huge crystas on\nthe ground zero, please destroy it so they can\nnever be able to use the wizard cannon...
Could you do that?
